intro.text: A lighteyed Alethi captainlord of the Cobalt Guard, assigned to protect Adolin Kholin.

items.text: During the Battle of the Tower, Kaladin told Malan to retreat, but he refused to leave Adolin. Instead he led the Cobalt Guard after Kaladin to rescue Dalinar from a Parshendi Shardbearer.
After the Battle of Narak, Dalinar said he would have put Malan in charge of investigating a murder in Urithiru had he still been alive. When exactly he died isn't clear.

appearance.text: Tall and stately, he wears a matching steel helm and breastplate over the dark blue uniform of a ranking officer of the Kholin army.

personality.text: Dutiful and careful to follow military procedure, he salutes crisply even in the middle of a deadly battle. Dalinar trusts him.
